label: GO step after a rewarded a2 trial, strongly committed to a2 (strongest on first reward after a non-reward)
explanation: Fires only at GO (0 activations at D1/D2), essentially only when the previous trial was rewarded (32911/33058 active steps) and the agent chooses a2 (33048/33058); prev_action is a2 or unknown, i.e. a win-stay on a2. The superset GO & prev_reward==1 & action==2 has recall 0.995 / mass 0.9996 but precision only 0.25: within it the feature is silent during long reward streaks. Magnitude is largest (near max) on the first rewarded a2 trial after an unrewarded one and decays over consecutive rewards (0.98 -> 0.14 -> 0.01 in example windows); it also requires a very confident a2 policy (choice logit < -8.9 holds 91% of mass) and fades late in the episode (almost nothing after trial 80). Recorded predicate adds the confident-a2 logit and that the reward two trials back was not 1 (dev P 0.44, R 0.65, F1 0.52, mass 0.85); adding ep_trial<80 gives F1 0.58. Uses only observed variables plus the agent own upcoming choice/logit. Never fires for a1 choices, after unrewarded trials, or at non-GO phases.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
